key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure (+30c/L)
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs; restructuring plan still has a long runway
Housing: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment shows resilience; no spring bounce in auctions
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy fears; Santos preservation noted
Oil price surge as suppression efforts fail, boosting energy sector but hitting consumer staples
Superannuation reform debate intensifying with One Nation proposals and structural critiques
Optus outage triggered welfare checks, highlighting critical infrastructure fragility

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; cap raises signal cash stress among juniors. Gold mixed ('schmould'). PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure. Junior miners (Aruma, Australasian) volatile. Gold miners (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer relative safety but lack momentum.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks tumbling on rising bond yields and rate fears. ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 job cuts) signals cost pressure. 172-year-old bank exploring token upside.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression risk if RBA holds. Credit growth may slow. Tokenisation narrative (federal bank token) is speculative.

sectors.trend: Positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails. Australia softens gas supply rules. Santos preservation noted as strategic sacrifice.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas policy easing. Fuel +30c/L hits WES.AX, CWP.AX margins. LNG export flexibility supports Asian demand.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached Price Freeze on staples. Women's clothing chain closed 177 stores. Businesses 'fear for their future'.
sectors.implications: Consumer spending under pressure from fuel and tax burden. WES.AX, CWP.AX margin squeeze. Discretionary names vulnerable.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable end resilient. No spring bounce in auctions. RBA worried about rental inflation. Debate on housing 'collapse' vs resilience.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield pressure. First-home buyer surge supports volume but not prices. Migrant-driven construction demand a tailwind.

sectors.trend: Selective. HIVE (HVN.AX) scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. Optus outage exposed infrastructure risk. Critical Resources battery tech in testing. Superannuation reform debate active.
sectors.implications: AI/cloud names (HVN.AX) gaining traction. CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable. Super fund flows may shift with reform proposals.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and rising bond yields pressuring equities broadly
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold flat
AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and fuel costs
Housing bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Superannuation reform political risk (One Nation proposals)
Energy security: gas supply rule changes and Santos strategy
AI/tech adoption accelerating in ASX-listed firms

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via short-duration bonds; favour fixed-income REITs over growth equities
Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or energy
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy consumer staples
Avoid luxury REITs; monitor GPW.AX, ICPS.AX for rental yield compression
Monitor One Nation proposals; assess impact on fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / fuel cost shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Benefit from energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); hedge consumer exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil surge and gas policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failing; Australia softening gas rules supports LNG export volumes

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exposure as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' but relative safe-haven demand rising with AUD weakness and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: AI/cloud infrastructure plays on enterprise adoption
opportunities.rationale: HIVE scaling BUZZ HPC; broader AI demand tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Affordable-housing REITs and builders on first-home buyer surge
opportunities.rationale: Affordable segment resilient; migrant-driven construction demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / large-cap mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting; cap raises signal cash stress; $90bn ASX drawdown
Rising bond yields and rate fears compress bank valuations; ANZ restructuring ongoing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer staples / discretionary on margin pressure
defensive_moves.rationale: Fuel +30c, Woolworths price breaches, retail closures signal demand weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as AUD weakens
defensive_moves.rationale: Growth scare, AUD smashed, imported inflation rising

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower on rate fears, iron ore weakness, and oil-driven inflation. AUD weakness adds imported cost pressure. RBA rental inflation concern limits easing options. Expect volatility in miners and banks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Energy transition (gas, battery tech), AI adoption, and affordable housing demand provide structural support. Superannuation reform could redirect flows. Iron ore recovery depends on China stimulus. Housing bifurcation to persist.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and rental inflation data
Iron ore price trajectory and China demand signals
ANZ restructuring execution and cost savings

Brent crude and Australian fuel pump prices
CPI and rental inflation data releases
